feature_contract.goal: Restore complete original stereo car-reflection update pacing when a Quest/OpenXR refresh-rate transition moves from 120 to stable 90/80/72/60 Hz, without teaching the late-frame limiter to accept isolated GPU overruns.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R84 original game Envmap_FaceCount temporal classifier and reflection cube-face budget only; protect SkyGlow, HUD/GOAL, original graphics, input/FFB, R26_SAFE and frozen DXVK.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Deterministic QPC source-path defect: after 120Hz healthy 8.333ms samples, 72Hz 13.889ms remains cadenceMiss forever because the existing late branch cannot adapt referenceSeconds. This permanently enforces the two-face late budget at valid 72Hz until a manual Reset; no hardware FPS gain is claimed.
trace_stages: Original OutRun EXE Envmap_FaceCount hook records QPC frame cadence in src/hooks_graphics.cpp.
R84 ReflectionFrameBudget::AdaptiveFrameCadence must distinguish sustained nominal refresh transitions from short deadline misses and long loading gaps.
Original D3D9 Envmap_RenderToCubeMap consumes bounded cube faces before the R84 two-eye VR rendering and OpenXR host presentation.
subcomponents: Conservative continuous nominal-Hz re-lock that remains late until twenty-four valid samples and rejects GPU spikes, noncanonical overload and interrupted transitions.
Retain original face count accumulation, desktop and VR-off reset, late-two-face protection, original >18ms cutoff and native 60Hz budget.
Executable portable C++ positive and adversarial regression, followed by final exact-SHA Windows R84/R26_SAFE game, host, package, Domain, Full Source Impact and HUD gate.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original EXE QPC to R84 headset refresh classifier
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Stable 120-to-90/80/72/60Hz and 90-to-72Hz sequences re-lock after 24 frames instead of remaining permanently late.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: D3D9 cubemap draw-budget safety and desktop fallback
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Single missed frames, sustained noncanonical 12ms GPU load, loading gaps, VR-off reset and ordinary desktop budget never masquerade as a refresh transition.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 game DLL and OpenXR host plus R26_SAFE package
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Compile changed-area native C++ behavior checks then pass non-skipped exact-SHA required Active, Domain, Full Source Impact and HUD GitHub Actions gates.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Code deterministic: 120Hz->72Hz makes 13.889ms greater than reference 8.333ms*1.2+.5ms; Observe() only retrains when !late, so it cannot recover by staying at 72Hz.
diagnosis.root_cause: The adaptive cadence state has no controlled slower-refresh re-lock after healthy 120Hz frames, trapping reflection submission in the late GPU budget after a headset rate decrease.
source_trace: EXE+0x1447E original reflection face-count hook samples QPC and holds the cadence object.
Observe() determines frameSpike before passing dt to reflection frameScale60.
Advance() limits original D3D9 cubemap GPU faces to 2 when frameSpike, ahead of headset eye transport.
alternatives_rejected: Do not simply raise the 120Hz late threshold: that would hide actual 12ms missed-refresh work.
Do not reduce cubemap resolution, remove reflections or modify per-eye image quality as an unmeasured FPS claim.
diagnosis.runtime_limit: Portable source regression and CI are not Quest3/VDXR hardware proof. Real refresh transition, GPU p95/p99 and image quality remain UNTESTED.

next_action: Run changed-area portable C++ regression and the required final exact-SHA GitHub Actions gates. Record C6 separately only after all Gate results are confirmed; Quest3/VDXR remains UNTESTED.
